annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2004 proposal for a directive adding re-usability, recyclability and recoverability requirements (85%/95% by mass) to EC vehicle type-approval for M1 and N1 vehicles, implementing the End-of-Life Vehicles Directive. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: New M1 and N1 vehicles must be re-usable/recyclable to 85% and re-usable/recoverable to 95% by mass
Manufacturers undergo preliminary assessment and obtain a Certificate of Compliance before type-approval
Calculations follow ISO 22628:2002 using reference vehicles
Ban on re-use of safety/environmental parts such as airbags, seat belts and catalytic converters in new vehicles
Exemptions for special purpose, multi-stage and small-series vehicles; amends Directive 70/156/EEC
